articleTitle: The role of generative AI in industrial design: enhancing the design process and education
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Generative AI's impact on industrial design processes and design knowledge learning was studied with 26 students at National United University. Findings suggest that AI is beneficial for developing creativity in the early design stages, but not recommended for later stages involving adjustments and optimizations. Cross-departmental communication complexity and professional parameters make AI unsuitable for engineering drawing and data handover. AI operation still requires substantial design knowledge, emphasizing the importance of design experience in decision-making.

articleTitle: SBC process algebra for model-driven engineering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The essence of Model Driven Engineering (MDE) is to bring structure/behavior together. We establish Structure-Behavior Coalescence Process Algebra (SBC-PA) as an MDE modeling language in this paper. SBC-PA uses a sole diagram to define the meaning of a software system. Hence, during the MDE SBC-PA modeling construction phase, the consistency of the model will be completely assured.

articleTitle: 266 nm AlGaN-based led with a low current efficiency droop
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: A 266 nm AlGaN-based light-emitting diode (LED) displays a low efficiency droop at the temperature range from 298 to 358 K was fabricated. The maximum external quantum efficiencies were 2.71 and 2.27% occurred at current density of 38 A cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> for 298 and 318 K, respectively. The current droop (J-droop) in each of these cases was less than 7%. Furthermore, when the temperature was increased to 358 K, the maximum EQE of 1.47% occurred at a current density of 63.3 and 88.6 A cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, and the J-droop was approximately 3.8%. The main mechanism responsible for overcoming the J-droop was the uniform distribution of the concentrations of injected electrons and holes within the multiple quantum wells through the enhanced hole injection efficiency and inhibited the Auger recombination mechanism in an experimental setting. This LED has the potential to replace existing ultraviolet light source, such as mercury lamp for a broad range of applications including disinfection and biomedical optoelectronics.

articleTitle: Predicting increments in heavy metal contamination in farmland soil
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Traditional pollution risk assessment approaches face difficulty to effectively reflect the current state of pollution. This study aims to investigate the use of logistic regression and deep neural networks as modelling approaches to predict the probability of recontamination of irrigation areas and the pollution increment for each agricultural land in Taoyuan City, following the remediation of agricultural land pollution. The study has sampled all contaminated 2,824 parcels of farmland in Taoyuan City, involving 9,674 data entries in recent 20 years. The increment of copper, zinc, and cadmium was predicted with an accuracy of 82%, 83%, and 91%, respectively, using logistic regression and ensemble learning. In particular, the predictive power of cadmium is the best, while the deep neural network model demonstrated a good fit between the predicted copper, zinc, and cadmium increments and the actual values. The R2 values obtained were 0.81, 0.82, and 0.98 respectively, with the predictive power of cadmium being particularly significant. This indicates that the model can effectively predict the increments in heavy metals such as copper, zinc, and cadmium in the farmland and select the farmland with the highest pollution recurrence risk as the main target for soil surveys.

articleTitle: Development of Surabaya Batik with the source of submarine monument ideas
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The submarine monument in Surabaya is the only largest submarine monument in Indonesia that used the former KRI Pasopati 410 submarine. The attraction of this submarine monument is as a means of heritage of historical educational values which is a mirror of the greatness of the Indonesian nation as a maritime nation to motivate people to know and love marine history more. The purpose of the study was to create a typical Surabaya batik motif with the source of the idea of a submarine monument. Batik is a handicraft by drawing on cloth by utilizing wax in the manufacturing process which has been produced for generations in Indonesia. The method used in this study is the Double Diamond Model which consists of 4 stages: discover, define, develop, and deliver. The results of this research are 3 batik designs that have been copyrighted and 3 written batik prototypes. The three designs are titled Monkasel 1, Monkasel 2 and Monkasel 3. The results of research in the form of batik design can be a means of promotion submarine monument tourism and become an alternative complement to submarine moumen tourism souvenirs.

articleTitle: Lane detection methods based on semantic segmentation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Image Segmentation is dividing objects in an image into meaningful units. To be more specific, it predicts which class each pixel in the image belongs to. When semantic segmentation is performed on an image, it is known which class each pixel belongs to, as shown in the following figure. Image segmentation is used in a wide range of fields such as medical image analysis (tumor boundary extraction, etc.), autonomous vehicles (road surface, pedestrian detection, etc.), and augmented reality. The main purpose of SegNet is a model designed to perform pixel-wise semantic segmentation of structures related to autonomous driving, such as roads, buildings, cars, and pedestrians. U-Net is mainly used in bio images, and instead of using Pooling Indices, the entire feature map is transferred from the encoder to the decoder and then concatenated to perform convolution. This makes the model larger and uses more memory.

articleTitle: Intelligent protection for airport potential threat
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Airplanes takes off and lands near the ground, where air drones may appear surrounding the airplanes. It is then inevitable that the precaution must be prepared much earlier in advance. Two systems are taken into account, including frequency hopping spread spectrum (FHSS) and wireless wideband local area network (via 5G WLAN). Both have their own strength and can be back up to each other. Disturbances onto the air drones may also be divided into two categories: stopping the communications between the air drones and the pilot and (1) sending the detected air drones back to where they were initiated or (2) just forcing the detected air drone to locally drop to the ground directly. It would be mandatory that the safety of passengers be put on the top priority.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based channel estimation for RIS-assisted UAV-enabled wireless communications system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Wireless communication via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has drawn a great deal of attention due to its flexibility in establishing line-of-sight (LoS) communications. However, in complex urban and dynamic environments, the movement of UAVs can be blocked by trees and high-rise buildings that obstruct directional paths. This problem can be effectively addressed by employing reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). To achieve this goal, accurate channel estimation in RIS-assisted UAV-enabled wireless communications is crucial. This paper proposes an accurate channel estimation model using long short-term memory (LSTM) for a multi-user RIS-assisted UAV-enabled wireless communications system. Simulation results showed that LSTM can effectively improve the channel estimation performance of RIS-assisted UAV-enabled wireless communications.

articleTitle: Research and design of a web-page virtual piano for music pedagogy
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Pianos are commonly used to teach basic music skills, but not all students have access to one. Virtual pianos can replace physical ones for easier access and online learning. This study analyses the advantages of digital media in music education. Additionally, based on experiences and suggestions of music learners and teachers gained through semi-structured interviews, a web-based virtual piano program suitable for teaching is proposed. The web-based virtual piano, created with JavaScript and Web Audio framework will aim to synchronously display piano keys, pitch notation, and related information in order to enhance teaching effectiveness and learning experience.

articleTitle: An event driven compensation low dropout regulator with adaptive self oscillating cross-feedback comparator and parallel shift register
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: With the development of electric vehicles (EVs), many vehicle sensors are gradually being integrated into electric cars. To enable vehicles to perform functions more quickly, in the power management system, higher transient response and faster recovery times becomes an emphasis. This paper presents "An Event Driven Compensation Low Dropout Regulator with Adaptive Self Oscillating Cross-Feedback Comparator and Parallel Shift Register". To accelerate chasing time, an adaptive frequency oscillator and four parallel shift registers are designed, allowing the circuit to operate at double the actual frequency, substantial reducing chasing time, and achieving low power consumption once a steady state is reached. The oscillator in this work apart from conventional ones is that it is composed of two comparators. By providing cross-feedback to each other, it can generate two clocks with different phases but same frequency. This oscillator allows the circuit to switch frequencies between 200MHz, 100MHz, and 10MHz, without the need for capacitors can achieve a fast-chasing time of <100ns and a low power consumption of 29.63μA. In the transient compensation circuit can detect transient conditions at any time, and compensation power is added afterward. This enables the circuit to quickly restart and keeps the transient voltage variation below 15%.

articleTitle: Smart water grids: solutions based on IoT and machine learning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Smart water grids (SWGs) are an emerging technology that combines the power of the Internet of Things (IoT) with advanced water management systems. These grids are designed to monitor and control water distribution in a more efficient and sustainable way, thus they are becoming increasingly important as water resources become scarcer. The key feature of SWGs is the ability to collect data in a continuum manner. In this paper, we discuss the potential benefits of the use of machine learning on IoT collected data. We also define a deep learning model to identify patterns in consumption data based on clustering. Experiments are performed on data gathered through a LoRaWAN IoT platform measuring a regional water distribution system. Thanks to this approach, we can help water utilities to adapt the distribution plan according to users' behaviours.

articleTitle: Highly stable BiFeO3 RRAM with multilevel storage application
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the fabrication process of BiFeO3 (BFO) thin film with sol-gel method and the device characteristics of BiFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> resistive random access memory (RRAM). The resistive states characteristics were obtained under Al/BiFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/ITO structure and showed good retention performance with no obvious degradation. RRAM here shows bipolar resistive switching characteristic for a hundred times switching cycles with a resistance ratio (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">HRS</sub>/R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">LRS</sub>) of more than 1 order and high stable retention characteristic for over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> seconds with a resistance ratio (RHRS/RLRS) of around 2 orders. In this study, our research group illustrates the application of BFO in the development of non-volatile memory.

articleTitle: A revised MCDM approach for determining criteria weights: the combination of Bayesian BWM and fuzzy DEMATEL
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Due to the analysis reliability and more comprehensive information obtained by Bayesian BWM, more and more scholars use this method to calculate the criteria weights in an evaluation system or solve multi-criteria decision problems. Even though, using of the Bayesian BWM just only obtain the importance weights of each criterion, the analysis results still lack a consideration of the intertwined factors of complex decision-making problems in the real world. Hence, in this paper, we combine the Bayesian BWM with the fuzzy DEMATEL to address above problem. The revised MCDM approach can consider the interdependence between criteria to help address the problem of Bayesian BWM of considering weights only in terms of importance. Therefore, we can modify the weights obtained with Bayesian BMW to match the real-world situation more closely.

articleTitle: Strategic thinking on the service-oriented transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industry under the theory of industrial design system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The article takes the strategy of industrial design to assist the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing servitization as the topic, clarifies the connotation and manifestations of manufacturing servitization, demonstrates the important role of industrial design in manufacturing servitization, and is based on the current problems of manufacturing servitization.

articleTitle: A study on the positive effects of artificial intelligence intervention in the artistic healing of meditation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Meditation has a positive artistic healing function in soothing the emotional trauma of individuals. Applying innovative achievements in artificial intelligence (AI) technology to meditation can provide a more favorable environment for its practice, actively promoting the release of artistic healing functions associated with meditation. This paper provides a concise elaboration on the artistic healing functions of meditation, discusses the feasibility of AI intervention in meditation, introduces real-world cases of AI involvement in meditation, and briefly summarizes the enhanced role of AI in the artistic healing functions of meditation.

articleTitle: Speaker clustering for the detection of mild cognitive impairment based on deep neural networks and audio signal
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In this paper, we propose speaker identification through speaker clustering for the detection of mild cognitive impairment (MCI). For dataset collection, we cooperated with a neurologist from a local hospital to obtain total 110 voice recordings of potential patients, including 79 MCI cases. We first extract 256 speaker features using the speaker embedding generated from the Pyannote toolkit with transfer learning and tuned parameters. Then, these speaker features are employed for speaker clustering by using K-means methods. To study the performance of speaker identification, the relevant confusion matrix is derived and the accuracy index is given. From the accuracy analysis, we can achieve 95% accuracy for the speaker identification, and 88% accuracy for the MCI detection using the multilayer perceptron (MLP) deep neural network.

articleTitle: Predicting heavy metal recontamination in farmland
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Taoyuan City ranks second in the nation in terms of land pollution area. Over the years, while the government has actively remediated a significant portion of contaminated land, the evolving nature of land characteristics continues to pose a threat of recontamination. Therefore, this study primarily focuses on cadmium (Cd), copper (Cu), and zinc (Zn) heavy metals and utilizes Python to construct a Random Forest model based on soil monitoring concentration changes and incremental heavy metal concentrations. Through a literature review, the relevant parameters of the model were determined. A dataset of 1,555 records from Taoyuan City's managed agricultural land over the past 18 years (2004-2021) was collected. Four commonly used algorithms were applied for prediction, with the Random Forest demonstrating the best performance, achieving an accuracy of 75.76% and an error rate of 0.05%. This indicates a certain level of reliability in the model. Furthermore, potential applications of the model are discussed, with the hope that relevant authorities can use this model to predict potential recontamination sites in the future. Environmental agencies can then strategically deploy monitoring and control measures, thereby avoiding unnecessary widespread testing and saving resources such as time, manpower, and finances.

articleTitle: A multi-loop control adaptive clocking digital low dropout regulator with median activation parallel successive-approximation register and compensation detect mechanism
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The sensors used in medical devices, such as temperature sensors, humidity sensors, fingerprint sensors, and others, are striving for low power consumption and high performance, driven by the rise of green energy technology. Therefore, in recent years, many system circuits designed for low operating voltage have been proposed, including transceivers, phase-locked loops, oscillators, analog-to-digital converters, and more. To address the aforementioned power requirements, this paper introduces a power management system titled "A Multi-Loop Control Adaptive Clocking Digital Low Dropout Regulator with Median Activation Parallel Successive-Approximation Register and Compensation Detect Mechanism." This system aims to deliver a stable 0.5V voltage output without the need for additional capacitors. Specifically, our contributions include the development of search logic for the entire register control system and the utilization of an adaptive clocking system to generate a 40MHz clock for chasing-state, achieving a settling time of 0.133μs. Furthermore, we reduce the steady-state operating frequency to 1MHz to attain a quiescent current of 12.57μA. Additionally, the compensation loop detection circuit achieves rapid transient response, ensuring that the variation in output voltage remains about 15%. The proposed Low Dropout Regulator is simulated and implemented using the standard 90nm CMOS simulation process.

articleTitle: Research on the correlation between poster color matching and topics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Many design-related departments in colleges encourage their students to participate in international design competitions in order to accumulate design experience. In these design competitions, poster works are considered to be one of the most artistic design projects, in which color is the most eye-catching element when viewed from a distance. In Taiwan International Student Design Competition (TISDC), the topic always varies every year, and therefore the present study explores the relationship between color and the topic. Particularly, we analyze the relationship between three color attributes (i.e., Hue, Value, and Chroma) and five color matching principles (i.e., Monochromatic, Analogous, Contrast, Complementary, and Ambiguous) of the poster works with the Visual Design category of the TISDC from 2008 to 2022 by using the ``content analysis method''. The samples selected for our study are generally those design works with neutral colors, high brightness and low color intensity. Based on the analysis, it is found that the color application method is generally related to the ``topic'', and consequently it is suggested that designers can think about the design based on the ``topic'' in terms of color application and use the monochromatic and contrast so that the visual balance in the design can be achieved.

articleTitle: Develop a bottom-up flood early warning system: a community perspective
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Extreme weather events have caused heavy rainfall and flooding in countries such as Japan and Libya. Experts analyse that strengthening flood control facilities alone will not be enough to cope with the heavy rainfall caused by extreme weather. It is important to enhance the preparedness of local residents to prevent and avoid disasters. The rapid development of sensors and the Internet of Things not only improves the efficiency of flood monitoring, but also reduces the maintenance cost of related sensors and systems. Therefore, a decentralized, bottom-up system architecture can be easily implemented at the community level. And that it can provide local residents with timely monitoring information and emergency response accordingly. To meet the needs of community-based flood emergency response, this research invents a flood monitoring sensor which has the advantages of easy installation, low cost and affordable maintenance fee. A web page with Responsive Web Design is also developed to interact with users for communication purposes. Finally, a rapid flood model is implemented to provide aerial flood forecasts after receiving point observations from the sensors. The above system has been integrated and implemented in a local community in Taipei, proving its promising potential for further applications in the future.

articleTitle: Effect of direct injected water distribution pattern on performance and emission characteristics of a gasoline direct injection engine - A CFD analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines have better fuel efficiency and higher power output than conventional engines. However, they tend to produce higher nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions, particularly at high-load conditions. Several strategies have been employed to mitigate these emissions, including exhaust gas recirculation (EGR), fuel injection timing optimisation, fuel additives, etc. However, it is found that direct water injection into the combustion chamber is one of the promising methods. Proper in-cylinder distribution of water can reduce emissions and improve engine performance. Therefore, in this study, an attempt has been made to evaluate the effect of variation of in-cylinder water distribution on the performance and emission characteristics of a GDI engine using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis. The analysis is made for the base engine without water injection and with water direct injection for the cases of homogenous, linear, and Gaussian distributions. A naturally aspirated, spray-guided, four-stroke GDI engine is considered for the analysis. Water distributions are achieved by carefully dividing the engine into spherical zones such that water quantity at the spark plug location is negligible and goes on to a maximum near the cylinder liner. The analysis is done under high-load conditions at a constant speed of 1000 rev/min with a compression ratio (CR) of 10. The water injector orientation angle is initially determined based on the engine design constraints and literature data. Then, a comparative analysis is done between various cases of water distributions along with the base case. The results showed that Gaussian water distributions inside the combustion chamber marginally improved the engine performance and reduced NOx emissions.

articleTitle: An ultra-low voltage charge pump with 83.6% peak voltage conversion efficiency
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IOT) facilitates communication between humans and objects, driving the advancement of wearable devices and making them more diverse in terms of functionality and style. For instance, smartwatches have evolved from simple timekeeping to capabilities such as sleep monitoring and heart rate measurement. Portable sensing devices may experience battery depletion due to prolonged usage, leading to interruptions in monitoring functions. Therefore, an energy harvesting system is necessary to sustain sensor operation. Since the available energy in environment is extremely weak, a power conversion system is required to boost ultra-low voltage to operational voltage range. As a result, a DC-DC boost converter with high conversion efficiency and extremely low operating voltage is crucial. The DC-DC boost convertor could not appropriate controlled while the input is extremely low. A start-up circuit with an ultra-low operating voltage charge pump is important. This paper presents an ultra-low voltage charge pump with 83.6% peak voltage conversion efficiency. The efficiency of proposed circuit is independent while the stages of charge pump increased when input voltage is as low as 100mV. We reduce reversion loss by biasing gate voltage of charge-transfer switch. The design was implemented by using 180-nm CMOS process.

articleTitle: Vertical city - sustainable solutions for metropolises
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The world is currently experiencing a wave of urbanization. According to United Nations predictions, nearly 70% of the world's population will reside in cities by 2050. The explosive growth of population is particularly severe in metropolitan areas. The rapid expansion of urban populations and the construction of urban land pose significant pressures on the sustainable development of cities. How can this problem be addressed? In this regard, vertical cities are a direct means to achieve this goal, providing a fresh perspective for the sustainable development of metropolitan areas. But how do vertical cities affect the sustainability of cities? Why can vertical cities become a new urban planning model for future metropolitan areas?

articleTitle: Mechanical efficiency of Simpson gear trains
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Simpson gear trains have the advantage of compactness, high speed reduction and capability of differential drive, so they are often used in automobile, aerospace, mill, and automation industries. The purpose of this paper is to propose a systematic methodology for the analysis of the mechanical efficiency of Simpson gear train. Based on the fundament circuits of epicyclic gear train, the kinematic structure of Simpson gear train is presented. Then, the equations of the kinematics and mechanical efficiency of the Simpson gear train have been constructed. The results of the paper provide a powerful tool for the analysis of the kinematics and mechanical efficiency of the Simpson gear trains.

articleTitle: Promising implicit indication by fitting algorithm on MOSFET electrical characteristic curves
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Using modified conventional formulas to fit the measured characteristic curves of transistors appears feasible. Even if no equivalent circuits are considered, the fitting works and some important parameters (kN, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>, λ) are successfully determined. Somehow, the fitting I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</sub> versus VDS do not perfectly match the measured data as shown. The differences between both are squared and summed over and can be used to tell how match the fitting is. The bigger discrepancy is recognized at around V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</sub>= (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</sub>-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>) and named ``kink'' where the saturation is approached from triode region. Also the measured current data is always lower than the fitting data at the kinks. Eliminating the kinks is interesting and possible from the engineering point of view.

articleTitle: A bidirectional power converter for AC grid and DC bus
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This paper presents the development of a bidirectional converter for AC grid and DC bus. The converter adopts a full-bridge structure and utilizes average current control and sine pulse width modulation techniques for power factor correction and inverter design. The system's control core is based on a control chip, combined with control technology. By sensing the input and output voltages, the pulse modulation period is calculated to enhance the compensation speed of the overall control loop. This enables the converter to exhibit high power factor and stable output voltage capabilities, while functioning as an inverter with enhanced system reliability in the reverse mode, achieving the objective of bidirectional electrical energy transmission. Finally, a maximum rated output of 1 kW experimental platform was constructed to emulate AC grid of 220 V and a DC bus of 400 V, thereby validating the theoretical analysis and design methods proposed in this paper. The experimental results showed that with an AC grid voltage of 220 V, the efficiency reached a maximum of 97.09%. In the reverse mode, the efficiency reached a maximum of 96.98%. Through the converter, energy was fed back to the AC grid, achieving the objective of bidirectional energy scheduling.

articleTitle: A study on the design scheme of agricultural plant protection UAV based on Kano-AHP
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Based on the Kano-AHP model, an innovative design scheme for agricultural plant protection UAV is proposed to enhance user satisfaction with plant protection UAV. The Kano model and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) are integrated into the system, clarifying the requirements and importance of each module of the UAV. The weights of the requirements are analysed and ranked in the Kano model, resulting in various evaluation indicators. Finally, a judgment matrix is constructed based on the collected data of the product scheme to complete the inspection and evaluation, and determine the optimal design scheme. The results show that the Kano-AHP model can effectively map the feedback from requirements analysis to functional design, which to a certain extent compensates for the shortcomings of traditional product design relying on subjective experience, making the product design more scientific and effective.

articleTitle: Machine-learning-assisted music conducting practice system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In this research, we introduce a machine-learning-assisted conducting practice system. By using the capabilities of machine learning in this system, conducting instructors are empowered to train a conducting gesture model to make the system capable of recognizing conducting movements. The system can capture the trajectory of conducting movements using mobile phones or three-axis sensors and play MIDI-based music, allowing trainees to practice movements using a readily available device easily. Moreover, our system divides the conducting gesture into several equal segments according to the meter of the music. This innovation can help the MIDI-based music more closely align with the speed of the user's conducting gestures, reducing the latency issues that otherwise often arise during virtual practice in other similar systems. Briefly, the system not only serves to facilitate trainees in practicing the movements but also enables novices to experience the artistic allure of conducting.

articleTitle: Design of augmented reality educational content based on a multi-modal approach for holistic development in early childhood
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This paper develops interactive educational content for music-based learning utilizing Augmented Reality (AR). Designed for toddlers and young children, the content aims to foster holistic development through multi-modal stimuli-including visual, auditory, and haptic elements-and the coordination of both fine and gross motor skills. The content employs a rhythm game style and consists of both software and hardware components. Within the software, an AR environment is constructed using Unity to simulate visual and auditory information. Various musical instruments in the AR environment enable user interaction based on rhythm notes generated according to the corresponding musical lyrics. The hardware includes AR glasses, a haptic stick, and a sensing pad. Visual and auditory feedback is relayed to the user through the AR glasses, while the haptic stick allows for striking the sensing pad. Simultaneously, the haptic stick appropriate proper tactile feedback, considering both the specific musical instrument being interacted with and the force of the strike, as measured by an integrated pressure sensor in the sensing pad. We expect that the proposed educational content will contribute to the holistic development of toddlers and young children by offering a more interactive and multi-sensory learning experience.

articleTitle: TEA-VITS: emotion voice synthesis based on temporal emotion analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Previous emotional TTS models based on two-stage pipelines are expensive to label to construct natural speech and complicated in the learning process. In addition, there is a problem in which there is a difference between the pitch of the voice and the labelling of the emotion. To address this problem, this study presents TEA-VITS, an End-to-End TTS using Speech-Emotion-Diarization (SED) to generate words with a clear emotional accent. TEA-VITS uses the SED method to recognize temporal emotion in a single voice and label temporal emotion classification changes in voice data for model learning. The results show that they become clearer in terms of emotion than previous emotional TTS models and present new directions for efficient and natural emotional expression synthesis.

articleTitle: Building an electronic Yueqing with switchable tuning systems for cultural preservation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The culture of traditional musical instrument performances has gradually declined over time. Despite the government's active efforts to preserve intangible culture, the changing contemporary music performance forms have necessitated adaptation for traditional instruments such as Yueqing, commonly utilized in traditional performances. This study focuses on the transformation of the Yueqing into an electric instrument using pressure sensors and MIDI technology, catering to the diverse tuning requirements of modern music performances. The introduction of this electronic Yueqing holds the potential to enhance cultural heritage preservation by providing increased performance opportunities.

articleTitle: Development of multi-sight video recording system for horizontal bar in gymnastics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In order to maintain the mobility of athletes, it is becoming increasingly important to use imaging technology to observe their performance. Especially for high-intensity sports, such as horizontal bars in gymnastics, athletes should not wear any motion detection devices while performing. Besides, the camera resolution and frame rate of smartphones are getting higher and higher. Therefore, we proposed a multi-sight video recording system based on smartphones and Wi-Fi network, which contains a server smartphone and two client smartphones. The server can ask all the clients to start recording and user does not have to prepare assistants to start the camera one by one at different locations. In addition, in order to allow users to operate this system easily, we have developed applications for the server and client. In terms of synchronous experiment results, the overall frame difference between two client smartphones in average is 1.986 frames. The highest average frame difference in single test is 3.896 frames and the lowest one is 0.525 frames. In this paper, the proposed smartphone-based multi-sight video recording system can help the researchers to record the posture of each athlete from different sights in a convenient way. In the future, the recorded videos can be used to analyze the performance parameters of each movement performed by gymnasts.

articleTitle: Generative AI models for virtual interviewers: applicability and performance comparison
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Interviewing processes are considered crucial steps in job hunting or college admissions, and effective practice plays a significant role in successfully navigating these stages. Although various platforms have recently emerged for practicing virtual interviews, they often lack the tension and realism of actual interviews due to repetitive and formal content. This study aims to analyze and compare the performance of different generative AI models for creating a diverse set of virtual interviewers. Specifically, we examine the characteristics and applicability of each model, as well as the differences and advantages between them, and evaluate the performance of the generated virtual interviewers. Through this analysis, we aim to propose solutions for enhancing the practicality and efficiency of virtual interviews.

articleTitle: The effect of a double-loop instructional framework on multi-modal learning in a 3D animation course
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In recent years, digital learning has undergone significant transformation. The role of educators has evolved beyond traditional classroom instruction to encompass various aspects, including classroom management, learning environment design, proficiency with digital tools, and effective communication of educational beliefs. This research is grounded in the teaching theory of "cognitive apprenticeship" and incorporates multi-modal learning activities within a double-loop instructional framework. The research findings demonstrate that an effective double-loop instructional design can enhance the execution of multi-modal learning activities and effectively tackle challenges related to professional skill acquisition. Notable outcomes from the experiment include consistent pedagogical alignment between two co-teachers, improved problem-solving skills within team-based assignments, and enhanced self-learning capabilities among students.

articleTitle: Assessing ductility behavior in beam web openings featuring double slotted holes under cyclic loading
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Nine sets of specimens as reduced-beam-section (RBS) beam-column joints were planned to discuss the ductility performance of beam webs employing a double-slot opening-type configuration. These specimens were designed with varying parameters, including the distance from the center of the web opening to the beam-column surface (L), the depth from the outer edge of the beam web opening to the flange (d), and the opening depth (Dv) of each single slot within the beam web. This study aimed to enhance the design of RBS beam-column joints with web openings, allowing the plastic hinges away from the column surface. Furthermore, to ensure compliance with the AISC seismic design provisions. Therefore, the ANSYS commercial software package was used to create a finite element analysis model based on the findings of non-RBS steel beam-column joint tests reported in the literature. The results showed that parameter d was significant, leading to improvements in moment strength and plastic hinge. The specimens L600-d108-Dv140 (L=600 mm, d=108 mm, Dv=140 mm) emerged as the most optimal specimen. It demonstrated compliance with the AISC seismic design provisions and effectively achieved the plastic hinges away from the beam-column surface.

articleTitle: Analysis of air filter media design
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This study uses experimental methods to analyze the filter material performance of vehicle air filters. The filter element of the air filter will directly affect the life of the engine. If the filter element cannot effectively filter out the dust in the air that is harmful to the engine, the engine will crack. This phenomenon will not only shorten the engine life, but also cause engine wear and indirect air pollution. In this study, two different filter materials were used, and the two filter materials were sprayed with three different oil contents of 7g, 14g and 20g respectively for testing. Analyze whether the oil content of the two filter materials affects the performance of the air filter. Its filtration performance is evaluated based on three items: ventilation resistance, dust capture capacity, and cleaning efficiency. As a result, generally speaking, if you want to protect the engine from being worn by dust, you need to use filter materials with high cleaning efficiency. However, high cleaning efficiency will also lead to high ventilation resistance. If the ventilation resistance is high, it will result in less air intake and reduced horsepower. Small. The results of this study can show the relationship between the oil content of filter paper and ventilation resistance, dust capture capacity and cleaning efficiency.

articleTitle: The design of virtual reality system for geography education
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In the past, teachers mostly used textbooks or globes to teach geography knowledge (such as location, latitude and longitude, time zones, etc.), and it was not easy for students to understand the course content. However, virtual reality (VR) technology has gradually matured in recent years, and students can experience different feelings through VR. This study is used the Unity 3D game engine to integrate the OpenXR development kit, 3D models, animation, music, and sound effects media materials to develop a VR geography teaching system. Through VR immersive learning, students can easily understand the relative position, absolute position, map knowledge. Students can also stimulate their interest in learning and thinking ability.

articleTitle: Analysis of electrical characteristics of commercial led flat panel lights during dimming process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The development of LED technology has made LED lighting widely used. High-efficiency LED drivers enable LED lamps to achieve energy conservation and carbon reduction, which has become a major trend in world lighting. This paper measures the electrical characteristics of 100%, 75%, 50%, 25%, 10%, and 0% of the rated power of commercial LED panel lights, and observes the power factor, current total harmonic distortion, and conversion efficiency. The measurement results of 10 sets of LED panel lights show that the electrical characteristics at rated power all comply with safety regulations, but when dimmed to less than 50% of rated power, many electrical characteristics do not comply with safety regulations. In addition, the rated power of commercial LED panel lights is designed to be below 40W. Although they can operate on 230V, their power factor, current total harmonic distortion, and conversion efficiency are worse than those operating on 120V.

articleTitle: The structure-behavior coalescence method -- toward a unified view of the software system in model-driven engineering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: A software metamodel, called Structure-Behavior Coalescence Process Algebra (SBC-PA), is proposed in this paper. An example of software metamodel using SBC-PA and the diagrammatic technique is given. SBC-PA can be used as a basis for software multi-view unification. Possible ways for projecting their views on the software system from SBC-PA are presented.

articleTitle: Environmental effects of ICT, innovation and renewable energy in upper-middle-income countries
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The advances in technology and innovation are prominent to boost the global economy. However, the rapid economic development in upper-middle-income countries has been coupled with an enormous expansion in carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. As ICT, innovation, and renewable energy are key initiatives aimed at addressing carbon emissions, the purpose of this research is to assess their effects on CO2 levels in upper-middle-income countries. Utilizing data from the period 2000 to 2019, this study explores the diverse impacts of ICT (including fixed telephone subscriptions, mobile cellular subscriptions, individuals using the internet, and fixed broadband subscriptions), innovation (encompassing research and development expenditure, patent applications, and trademark applications), and renewable energy on CO2 emissions. The results show that ICT and innovation indicators are positively related to CO2 emissions and renewable energy is negatively related to CO2 emissions. During the use phase of ICT and innovative hardware, energy consumption deteriorates the environment; when ICT and innovative technology reaches the end of their useful life, recycling, disposal of e-waste in landfills, or disassembly are all environmental implications. The recommendations of this study show that it is necessary to determine how ICT and innovation may be used most effectively to decrease harmful emissions to the environment. More renewable energy should be introduced to lessen reliance on fossil fuels in order to offset any environmental harm posed by electricity usage. The novelty of this study shows that although ICT and innovation are important components for transforming a middle-income economy in-to a high-income economy, ineffectiveness in managing them that causes harmful effects on the environment could cause them to fail to transition to a high-income economy.

articleTitle: Use of the A6 metric to evaluate university students' online performance in Taiwan
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This research uses the newly formulated A6 metric to investigate and evaluate Taiwanese university students' online performance and mobile learning experiences. There were 416 university students who used their smartphones to take part in the online survey during October 2023. The results discussed in the paper indicated that five factors (Accessibility, Affordability, Adoptability, Adaptability, and Acceptability) had a positive feedback. However, Appropriateness related to culturally sensitive issues were needed to be strengthened. The researchers aimed to provide pedagogical guidance for university teachers, students, higher education administrators, and policymakers for future mobile teaching and learning improvements.

articleTitle: Enhancement on electroluminescence of OLEDs with high transmittance and low resistance of NiO/ITO composite anode
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This paper presents the use of composite NiO/ITO as a transparent conductive anode to enhance the electroluminescence (EL) of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs). The work function of NiO/ITO was approximately of 5.1 eV, which falls between that of ITO (4.8 eV) and NPB (5.4 eV). Consequently, the use of a NiO/ITO anode enhanced hole injection, leading to charge balance in the Alq<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> emission layer. Hall measurement revealed that the carrier concentration in the NiO/ITO decreased with an increase in NiO thickness, thereby increasing the sheet resistance of the anode. When a 1 nm-thick NiO was deposited on the ITO glass, the mobility of NiO/ITO increased to 30.72 m<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub> s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub>, compared to 30.61 m<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub> s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sub> for ITO. articleTitle: TENG with PDMS modified by sputtered ZnO films
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In this work, polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) was spin-coated onto the substrate and cured in an oven at 85 °C for 1 h. Zinc oxide (ZnO) was deposited on the surface of PDMS for different deposited times. Diluted hydrochloric acid was used as a sacrificial solution to remove the ZnO layer, thereby creating microstructures on the friction surface. The voltage response of the device was measured using an oscilloscope, and the current response was analyzed using a series-connected voltage divider. The best response was observed for 30 min deposition with a voltage of 47.2 V. The power densities of planar TENG (0 min) and microstructured TENG (30 min) were 0.3159 and 7.29 μW/cm2, respectively. It indicated that the microstructured ZnO surface can effectively improve the output performance.

articleTitle: Improvement of labelling with OPEN CV in bike fitting
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Bike fitting is used to prevent injuries, increase comfort and efficiently improve cyclist performance. In the past, it was usually be done manually by an expert. However, this is both expensive and inconvenient. There are some companies offering APPs that use a mobile device to achieve bike fitting outdoors more easily. Using this approach to bike fitting requires labelling the key joints of body to evaluate the motions of riding a bike. The evaluation results offer guidelines to the cyclists on how to adjust the seat and handles of bikes. Obviously, labelling the key joints requires a lot of selection time interacting manually with the mobile device. In our research, OPEN CV blob detection is applied to reduce manual selection time. However, though it works when given a good target colour range to find all labels. It is not easy to achieve the goal of only manually picking one seed point. In this paper, a self-adaptive target colour range method is proposed to work with Open CV colour blobs detection. It fits the requirement of "one manual pick then all labels found automatically". The experimental results shows that it reduces a lot of burden of use.

articleTitle: An enhanced all-digital CMOS capacitor-type pulse-varying mechanism for low-cost wide-range time-to-digital converters
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This paper introduces an all-digital CMOS enhanced capacitor-type pulse-varying (shrinking) mechanism designed to improve resolution for low-cost wide-range time-to-digital converters (TDCs). The mechanism utilizes a size-ratioed MOS capacitor coupled with homogeneous gates within the delay line, functioning as a pulse-varying cell to achieve time attenuation and improved time resolution. Unlike a previous capacitor-type mechanism, the proposed approach employs a longer channel length to extend the measurement range while maintaining high time resolution. It offers the advantages of linearly varying resolution and resolution enhancement. This study avoids time-consuming full-custom CMOS design, opting for a fully digital CMOS approach using a TSMC 0.35-μm CMOS process. After circuit layout and HSPICE simulation, the experimental results demonstrate the benefits of a simple structure and resolution enhancement while maintaining lower cost and an expansive measurement range for TDC applications.

articleTitle: Optimization research on the application of art therapy with artificial intelligence perspective
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This article provides a concise exposition of the essence of applying artificial intelligence to art therapy. It highlights the current problems in the application of artificial intelligence in art therapy and proposes strategies to optimize its application.

articleTitle: Research on load testing for suspension bridge inspection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract:
This study:

Consolidates the results of load tests conducted on three suspension bridges in Taiwan.

Takes into account the latest research literature.

Integrates operational procedures and guidelines for suspension bridge inspections.

 The primary contribution of this research lies in proposing a method to determine the slackness or over-tightening of suspension cables using field load test results combined with numerical simulations as a basis for maintenance decisions. The results of this study are expected to be applied to suspension bridge inspections, aiming to enhance efficiency and inspection outcomes.

articleTitle: Integrated light-ResNet and Poolformer networks for shape-preserving lane detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The automatic Lane detector will be a useful safety-reliable apparatus in the autonomous vehicle if it can suppress the misses, fakes in lane detections to help unveiling the car-intruded lane-occlusions just in time. By the video captured in adverse environments, the road lane distortions including occlusion, rain reflections, heavy shadows, and paint-peeling can often let the lightweight lane detector fall in puzzling for a while, hence certainly impact the self-drive safety. Hence, in this study, the lane detection networks composed of a primary detector, which is the launched ultra-fast lane detector using RestNet16, and a prediction-refiner based on Poolformer is introduced for recovering the occluded portions and the natural smooth shape of curve lanes. The Poolformer refiner contains a single channel-MLP according to a coarse-to-fine recursive training scheme. When the difference of inferenced patterns between the primary detector and the Poolformer refiner exceed the tolerable risk threshold, the replacement is bypassed. Hence, the proposed refiner in our system such as is a revision-conditional rectifier to actually achieve appropriate and effective refinement. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed rectifier in the revision-conditional way can rapidly recuperate the lane marks for adequate structure integrity to benefit the self-driving safety.

articleTitle: Electrical performance of insulated gated bipolar transistor (IGBT) addressed by promising mechanism
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) may convey high current and sustain high breakdown voltages; it may provide high power control. In a sense, how IGBT demonstrates the capability of power control was not specifically described, and the equivalent bipolar junction transistors (BJT) activated by an applied bias to the insulated gate is intriguing. As seen Fig 1, IGBT shows an equivalent circuit structure containing two types of BJT, (NPN-type Bipolar transistor and PNP-type Bipolar transistor), which can be modeled as diode-associated transistor. Apparently, as a bias applies to the controlling gate, the channel beneath the gate oxide gets strongly inversed and turns out to be conductive just like what happens on metal-oxide-silicon field effect transistor (MOSFET), which provides necessary igniting currents to both BJTs and thus causes high current gain flowing through them-selves from the bottom. A renewed formula is provided for addressing the above scenario and successfully fitting the measured data that forms the characteristic curves. The underlying physics gets explored by using some parameters in the proposed formula, which contains threshold voltage and Early-Voltage-related lambda for MOSFET. IGBT thus enjoy high input impedance and high current gain due to MOSFET (Insulated Gate) and BJT, respectively. This formula combines both merits of MOSFET and BJT in order to fit the measured data. Indeed, the formula intimately fits IGBT electrical characteristic curves, and thus may be qualified and served as a model. The new model is then advisable for designing power integrated circuit to exactly achieve power saving, power control, and power efficiency.

articleTitle: A conceptual design of a deep learning framework for emotion-driven optimization of virtual reality content
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This study introduces a concept of the innovative framework designed to enhance the quality of conventional Virtual Reality (VR) experiences by leveraging the indirect emotion recognition technique for VR participants. Specifically, we concentrate on VR environments capable of mapping a user's facial expression onto a corresponding avatar. The user's emotion is indirectly inferred through the emotive expressions displayed by their avatar. In order to achieve accurate emotion recognition, we employ a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based deep learning algorithm. The algorithm successfully categorizes emotions into one of seven distinct states-anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and neutrality-with an accuracy rate of 87%. The results of this emotion analysis are systematically archived and visualized for in-depth evaluation. We expect that the proposed framework could offer VR development companies a robust tool for timeline-based user response analysis, thereby enabling them to refine and optimize their VR content in alignment with user sentiment.

articleTitle: A graph representation of planetary gear trains with any number of degrees of freedoms
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to propose a system approach based on graph theory to represent planetary gear trains with any number of degrees of freedoms. A regular graph representation of the kinematic structure of planetary gear train with any number of degrees of freedoms is given using polygonal graph representation. Then, the adjacency matrix rules for planetary gear train with any number of degrees of freedoms were established. The results of this paper provide a powerful tool for the analysing the topological structure of the planetary gear train with any number of degrees of freedoms.

articleTitle: Smart machines apply virtual reality technology to immersive learning applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This research is a virtual reality CNC machine operation and programming learning environment that provides real simulation of CNC machine operations such as robotic arms, three-axis processing machines, and five-axis processing machines,allowing users to learn and practice safely, and improve their skills. professional skill. This is of great value to learners in mechanical engineering, manufacturing and other fields. No matter beginners or experienced people, they can continuously improve their operating and programming skills in this virtual environment.

articleTitle: The innovative application in human health impact of Tianmu energy ceramics
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This article mainly explores the innovative application of Tianmu energy ceramics in the field of ceramic vessels. Traditional ceramic vessels only have practical functions for storing tea or food in daily use. Tianmu energy ceramics improve the technical formula by adding bixi jade, magnetite, and various rare earth elements based on the original Tianmu glaze formula. This enables the ceramics to generate electromagnetic wave vibrations and produce far infrared rays and negative oxygen ions. This helps to transform ``original water molecules'' into ``small molecule water'' and has a positive impact on human health. This paper will illustrate the advantages of Tianmu energy ceramics in terms of health functions through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, and discuss its innovative application in ceramic formula field.

articleTitle: Position control of a piezoelectric bimorph beam
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This study focuses mainly on using the inverse piezoelectric effect as an actuator that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. The electrical energy source may be a current, voltage, or pulse, etc. Typically, the maximum elongation of a piezoelectric actuator is only at the scale of microns, and the resolution can be at the nano-scale. The advantages are high rigidity and fast response, making piezoelectric actuators ideal for application in precise positioning technology.

articleTitle: DC and RF characteristics of T-gate AlGaN/GaN HEMTs using a ZEP520A (1:1)/LOR5B/ZEP520A photoresist and SiN passivation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: In this study, the three-layer photoresist structure ZEP520A(1:1)/LOR5B/ZEP520A was designed and a T-shaped gate AlGaN/GaN high-electron mobility transistor was fabricated using electron-beam lithography. The high-frequency performance was investigated using a GSG probe and exhibited a current gain cut-off frequency of 10 GHz and maximum oscillate frequency of 18 GHz when the gate voltage is -3.5V, and the drain voltage is 6 V.

articleTitle: The influence of interlocking directorates on the outcomes of initial public offerings and post IPO long-term performance
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: This study investigates the influence of a firm.s interlocked directorate network on the outcomes of initial public offerings (IPO) and post IPO long-term performance. We find that IPO firms having greater number of interlocking directorate ties, or occupying a more central position in the directorate network allow them to: (i) attract more prestigious underwriters and greater institutional interest; (ii) experience lower levels of underpricing, lower underwriting expenses and larger IPO offer sizes when undertaking IPOs, and (iii) achieve superior long- term performance post IPO. Moreover, the favorable impacts of the network of interlocking directorates on the performance of IPOs are magnified when firms operate in high-tech environments or have smaller firm size. The results of this study help to learn if the directorate network resource may mitigate the liability of newness of IPO firms as well as certify its value, thereby providing valid support to the resource dependence theory.

articleTitle: An action research of augmented reality assisted teaching application-basketball assisted teaching for elementary school students
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the differences in teachers' use of virtual reality-assisted basketball teaching in physical education courses on primary school students' sports attitudes, cognition and competition performance, as well as the teachers' reflection and growth during the action research process. The results show that virtual reality-assisted teaching can enable students to better understand the course content and have a personalized learning model. Virtual reality-assisted teaching can help students comprehensively understand various tactics, change the original playing mode, and also promote cooperation with teammates. cooperation between. Conclusion: Virtual reality-assisted basketball teaching can enhance students' sports attitudes and cognitive learning, and can improve students' competition performance. The implementation process relies on continuous reflection and revision, so teachers can also absorb experience and grow.

articleTitle: Research on the communication strategy of intangible cultural heritage driven by digital technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE 2023)
abstract: The rapid updating and wide application of information and digital technology has provided rich means and diversified paths for the protection and repair of intangible cultural heritage, and has also become one of the main ways of dissemination of intangible cultural heritage. Firstly, the current situation of digital protection and inheritance of intangible cultural heritage is analyzed. Then, we introduce the theory of design affairs, systematically analyze the "5W model" theory proposed by Harold Lasswell from the target relationship between external and internal factors, and construct the target system model based on the "5W model". Finally, it puts forward a new strategy for the dissemination of intangible cultural heritage, advocating the use of digital technology to improve the dissemination of intangible cultural heritage, expand the dissemination channels of intangible cultural heritage, and enlarge the dissemination scope of intangible cultural heritage.
